upstreamCatalog.relationship: This inventory catalog is the current fail-closed surface-to-protocol index. Closed draft PR #23185 is retained only as a design reference for a richer provider conformance catalog; it is not merged code, evidence, or a required stack.

rules.noExternalServiceReason: Agent providers and routes expose in-process runtime state and the authenticated local agent HTTP API; connector and model protocols are registered by their owning plugins.
Cloud API route registrations are inbound control-plane boundaries; queues, workers, databases, and object stores are inventoried as their own runtime surfaces rather than inferred from npm imports.
Core registrations define framework-local message, context, and test routes and do not select an external provider protocol.
Orchestrator routes are authenticated local runtime control endpoints.
Skill providers and routes expose the local installed-skill registry and package state.
